notes: Reference date 2018-02-26. Reference period academic year 2017-18.

Governing documents for faculty leave are saved (BN 4 FMLA/WFMLA, BN 3 sick leave, BN 8 non-medical leave, S-36 leaves of absence, Ch. 5 tenure-clock provisions), so missing is false (The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply). 2018_01 and 2018_03 are HR summaries; 2018_03's disclaimer says the formal documents govern.

Version: Ch. 5 is the July 2018 edition (captured 2019-02-06); 5.13(4), 5.131(2) and 5.135 carry amendment histories ending 1986 and 2011, so their text was in force on 2018-02-26. The other sections used carry no post-reference-date amendments. BN 3, BN 4, BN 8 are effective 2015-07-01; S-36 is Rev(3) 2002.

No paid parental leave, childbirth benefit, modified duties or teaching relief exists in the saved sources. Paid time for a birth comes only from the employee's own sick-leave balance (c4; pregnancy and adoption are listed uses) and, for 12-month appointees only, vacation and floating holidays (c10, c11). Academic-year faculty earn neither vacation nor floating holidays.

Sick leave Initial Entitlement: 176 hours (22 days) usable in the first 18 months of employment, credited without accrual; a member with two years of service (U8) is past it and on the accrual of 96 hours (12 days) per fiscal year. Recorded in c4's duration_note, not as a separate employer plan (the member described by the figures does not hold it).

Not coded as components: legal holidays (fixed closure days); leave without pay used in lieu of sick leave (BN 3 4.C(2), covered by c5/c6 and the W/FMLA leaves); paid leave banks (Annual Leave Reserve Account, sabbatical account; BN 1 not saved); Catastrophic Leave Program (BN 5, named only, not saved); income continuation insurance (S-36 H.2 states only that the state continues premium contributions for three months of a leave; plan not saved); continuation of health-insurance contributions during W/FMLA leave and the first three months of a leave of absence (benefit continuation, not leave or pay).

Documents cited but not saved: Wis. Stat. § 103.10 and Wis. Admin. Code § DWD 225 (WFMLA); 29 C.F.R. Part 825; UPS Operational Policies BN 1 (vacation, paid leave banks), BN 2 (personal and legal holidays), BN 5 (Catastrophic Leave Program), BN 6, BN 7 (miscellaneous leave), BN 9 (military leave), GEN 0, GEN 2, GEN 10, HR 4, HR 7, TR 2, TR 3; UW System Administrative Policy 160 (sabbatical); Regent Policy 89-9 / RPD 20-6 / Resolution 8457; UWM SAAP S-40, S-43; Faculty, Academic Staff, Limited Appointees Personnel Policies and Procedures Chapter 16.02; Wis. Adm. Code UWS 3.04 and UWS 19; Wis. Stat. § 36.30; UWM P&P Chapter 6 A2.3; Wisconsin HR Handbook Chapters 724, 740, 758; ERD comparison of federal and Wisconsin FMLA and publication ERD-7983-P; Academic Staff Personnel Policies and Procedures 104.03.
WFMLA eligibility differs from FMLA (52 consecutive weeks and 1,000 hours vs 12 months and 1,250 hours); the member described by the figures (two years' service) meets both.

BN 4 4: 'The provision of the WFMLA, FMLA, or University of Wisconsin leave policy that provides the most generous benefit to the employee must be applied.' BN 4 C(3) caps birth/adoption leave at six weeks of WFMLA and twelve weeks of FMLA per child; since the two run concurrently, no leave_limits entry is needed beyond the components' own lengths.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks unpaid (c1), with WFMLA 6-week birth leave (c2) and WFMLA 2-week own-health leave (c3) concurrent with it from its start, own sick-leave balance (c4) paid within it → then, at the chancellor's discretion, BN 8 / S-36 unpaid leave of absence beyond W/FMLA (c5, concurrent with c6; general purpose, counted in no figure).

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks unpaid (c1), with WFMLA 6-week birth leave (c2) and WFMLA 2-week family-care leave (c3) concurrent with it, own sick-leave balance (c4; family care up to five consecutive work days without further approval) paid within it → then BN 8 / S-36 unpaid leave of absence (c5, c6; general purpose). Tenure clock: childbirth/adoption extension (c8, presumption of approval) for either parent; exclusion of any leave of absence from the probationary period (c7, general purpose).
